scope: Targeted follow-up of four already catalogued primary papers. Reused cached original texts, fixed repository snapshots and selected source files; no new broad survey, source changes, models, simulator executions, training or paid calls.
user_objective: Both RoomGenBench asset generation/assembly and robot navigation/manipulation matter. Aesthetics is auxiliary. Keep scene realization success and task execution success as separate measured endpoints.

evidence_taxonomy.E1: Actual policy or planner execution with defined task outcomes and episode count.
evidence_taxonomy.E2: Quantitative geometric reachability, collision, contact or stability proxy; no executed-policy success implication.
evidence_taxonomy.E3: Qualitative simulator/robot demonstration without reported episode denominator or task-success protocol.
evidence_taxonomy.E5: Quantitative non-robot downstream learning task; useful but not navigation/manipulation evidence.

papers.name: PhyScene

navigation.task: Average object reachability from a random starting point on the floor and largest walkable component / total walkable area. Agent size matters.
navigation.scale: Paper evaluates scene metrics on1000synthesized scenes; this is not1000policy-rollout episodes. Appendix agent-width comparisons use0.2,0.3,0.5metres.
navigation.success_definition: Geometric reachable-object rate and free-space connectivity, not language-goal navigation success/SPL under an executed perception/action policy.
navigation.implementation_detail: Guidance maps boxes to floor occupancy, dilates for agent width and usesA*paths to guide layouts. Guidance proxy and evaluation CAD occupancy are distinct.
navigation.executed_policy_success_reported: No quantitative robot navigation policy success protocol established in reviewed sections.

manipulation.task: AppendixG extends walkability to interaction endpoints with fully-open articulated envelopes and paths toward handles/interactive areas.
manipulation.scale: AppendixG reports simplified interactiveness0.101→0.143; no rollout episode denominator found there.
manipulation.success_definition: Robot can geometrically reach the endpoint of a maximally interacted part. This is not successful grasp/contact execution and drawer/cabinet opening.
manipulation.claim_boundary: Paper explicitly describes it as a preliminary simplified estimate; heterogeneous grasping/motion-planning modules are not jointly solved.

official_interface.verified_scope: Previously read launcher invokes scripts/eval/calc_ckl.py with floor conditioning, mesh overlap mode and1000scene generation. No robot task executor or full reachability scorer was newly audited/executed.
official_interface.not_equivalent: A scene-generation/evaluation launcher is not an executed robot task benchmark.

papers.use_for_fastfill: Borrow agent-width/door or functional-approach geometry and articulated swept-volume stress tests as proxies. To claim task improvement, run a common actual navigation/manipulation policy with fixed tasks and failures retained.

papers.name: SceneSmith

actual_policy_experiment.task: Four pick-and-place tasks: fruit from bowl→plate; coke can from shelf→table; cup from floor→sink; water bottle kitchen→living-room coffee table.
actual_policy_experiment.scale: 100generated scenes,25per task; three room-level tasks and one house-level task.
actual_policy_experiment.robot_policy: Model-based KUKA LBR iiwa14 with mobile base and telescoping lift; segmented point clouds, grasp sampling,collision-awareIK,RRT-Connect and trajectory limits. Degraded variant relaxes gripper motion/clearance constraints.
actual_policy_experiment.success_definition: An evaluator agent inspects final state using signed distances/support/overlap and multi-view vision, checking task requirements over candidate object pairs. This is not just scene geometry.
actual_policy_experiment.validator_check: Authors manually labeled300evaluations: initial,standard-result,degraded-result for each scene;299/300agreement(99.7%).
inference_limits: These counts compare two policies inside generated scenes; they do not establish SceneSmith layout generation beats other scene generators on task success.
No independent statistical significance established here for16versus12successes.
299/300agreement applies to this evaluation set; not proof of universal validator accuracy.
The house-level bring task includes mobility, but no separate standardized ObjectNav/SPL benchmark is established.

papers.qualitative_only: Section4.4 separately shows RB-Y1 teleoperation and an external zero-shot policy moving an apple bowl→cuttingboard. Do not count video demonstrations as the100-scene task benchmark or generalization success rates.
papers.geometry_only: COL and5-second static-equilibrium metrics are physical proxies, not the16% task-success metric.

official_interface.verified_code_definition: Current validator maps requirements to0/0.5/1, averages them, and overall_success is average>=0.9. This is not equivalent to requiring every mandatory goal predicate true.
official_interface.other_interfaces: Public scripts generate_prompts.py and policy_interface.py support task→scene prompts and goal bindings/pose targets. Their presence does not independently certify the entire paper KUKA execution pipeline or100-scene artifacts are reproducible.

papers.use_for_fastfill: Reuse the distinction between initial non-goal state,actual policy rollout and final-state task verification. Add hard mandatory goal checks for the selected task; keep the policy,robot,asset physics andbudgetcommon across layouts.

papers.name: SceneCode

navigation.reported: SceneEvalNAV/ACC are scene proxies. No explicit navigation-policy episode count/success protocol found in reviewed evaluation.
navigation.boundary: 30room prompts are scene-synthesis evaluation units, not30robot episodes.

manipulation.task: Generated articulated asset imported intoMuJoCo; a robot physically opens or slides independent movable links with compiled joints.
manipulation.scale: Figure5/Section4.4qualitative demonstration. Robot episode count,randomization protocol and aggregate success rate are not reported in that section.
manipulation.success_definition: No task-level binary success threshold or repeated-rollout denominator established. Demonstrates contact/articulation capability, not measured manipulation success improvement.

papers.asset_realization: Part-aware programs compile rigid/articulated objects intoSDFwith approximate mass,inertia,collision proxies andjoint metadata. This is relevant to downstream assembly but does not guarantee realistic dynamics or successful manipulation.

official_interface.verified_scope: Read current robotvalidate wrapper andsuccessscorelogic this turn: state/DMD/task inputs andmeanrequirement score>=0.9. Exporter exists in pinned complete tree; its body was not audited here.
official_interface.critical_boundary: Public robot_eval utility does not upgrade the paper qualitativeMuJoCodemo to a reported quantitative task benchmark. No demo reproduction executed.

papers.use_for_fastfill: Relevant to object-level articulation andsimulatormetadata handoff. Evaluate jointlimits,collisionproperties andtaskaffordances on realizedmeshes; measure actualrollout success separately.

papers.name: Infinigen Indoors

navigation_manipulation.reported: Exports scenes/assets toIsaacSim,Unreal androbotdescription formats; illustrated interactive frame rates. Reviewed experiments do not report a robot-navigation/manipulation policy benchmark.
navigation_manipulation.boundary: Scene export/load is compatibility evidence, not success of a navigation/manipulation task.

actual_quantitative_downstream.scale: 2000synthetic shadow/shadow-free image pairs;compareShadowFormer trained onISTDrealdata alone versusreal+synthetic.
actual_quantitative_downstream.result_boundary: Synthetic addition slightly worsens in-domainISTDbut improves zero-shotSRD; not universal improvement orroboticsuccess.
A quantitative perception/data-generation task; notnav/manip rollout. Curated synthetic test-set size not established here.

official_interface.verified_scope: Read CLI main/argument surface: input_folder,output_folder,format,individual,omniverse,etc. Current repository also has simulator exporters and occlusion-mask generation paths; these are export/data utilities.
official_interface.unverified: Original shadow-removal andocclusion task train/eval entrypoints were not located andfullyaudited inthis follow-up; no quantitative model orsimulatorruns executed.
official_interface.version_limit: Pinned current repository has evolved since2024paper; current exporter functionality is not proof every paper experiment is released at this commit.

papers.use_for_fastfill: Useful for generating diverse controllable assets/geometry/annotations andsimulator export. For robot task claims, separately create a fixed-policy task evaluation. Aesthetic preference is optional; appearance realism may still matter for a visionpolicy.

paired_endpoints: All-request exact inventory andreal-meshgeneration/assembly coverage,fallbacks,geometry/support validity.
Taskepisodes withfixedrobot/policy/initialstate/goal andvaliditycriteria; reportall-requestend-to-endtask success andconditional-on-valid-assembly success separately.
implications_for_our_evaluation.nav_minimum: Defineagentfootprint,height,motionconstraints,start/goal distribution,doorlocations andsensor/policy. Door-seededpathfeasibility is anengineeringproxy; executed episode success/SPL is the taskendpoint whennavigationisrun.
implications_for_our_evaluation.manip_minimum: Requireinitialstate notalreadygoal;fixrobot/controller,grasp andplanningbudget,objectmass/friction/collision/joints andgoals. Hardgoalcriteria shouldnot be dilutedbyaveraging withunrelatedrequirements.
implications_for_our_evaluation.statistical_unit: Pairlayouts on the same tasks,assetdraws andpolicyseeds;cluster byhouse/source andnestmultipleepisodes withinroom. Keepgenerationfailure andtimeout denominators.
implications_for_our_evaluation.baseline: WinningGPTone-shot remains essential;same asset realization,physics adaptation andpolicy forGPT/LayoutVLM/FastFill. Do not compare paperreportednumbers acrossdifferent environments.
implications_for_our_evaluation.aesthetics: Auxiliary by default. Category/identity/visibility andrealisticvisual cues can be task-relevant for perception,which differs from beauty.
implications_for_our_evaluation.scope_boundary: Four selected sources only; this is not a comprehensive survey of robotic navigation/manipulation benchmarks or everydownstream task.

no_execution_claim: No scene load,static geometry score,physics simulation,task policy,paid judge,model inference ortraining executed inthis task. Source code andpaper evidence only.
